__map.learned: Tokenizer: reject any second dot or a dot with no digits; 1e3 splits into num then id.
Parser: unary sits below ^ (so -2^2 is (-2)^2); range checked before TRUE/FALSE; empty input and leftovers throw SyntaxError.
VALUES: plain number = optional sign, digits with at most one dot, no exponent, space padding only; reuse one regex for toNumber and parseLiteral
CELLS: isRef uppercase-only, no leading zero; rangeCells column-major over normalized rectangle; refsOf skips invalid refs/ranges and walks neg/bin/call
FORMAT: round with Number(n.toFixed(9)), normalise -0, pass errors/text through; import isError from ../VALUES/values.mjs
FUNCTIONS: range cells via ctx.cell (numbers only, first error returns), other args evaluate+toNumber; IF checks error then toNumber(c) error before branching, evaluates one branch only
GRAPH: iterative Tarjan over keys and targets; SCC size>=2 or self-edge counts; dependants of a cycle excluded
Tokenizer edge cases worth probing: multi-dot numbers, lone dot, greedy two-char ops, no string escapes.
VALUES: probe exponent, hex, Infinity, lone sign/dot and whitespace-only text; all must be #VALUE!.
CELLS: probe leading-zero rows, A100, reversed corners and invalid refs inside ranges for refsOf.
FORMAT: probe -0 after rounding, tiny negatives and very large numbers.
FUNCTIONS: probe IF lazy branches by counting evaluate calls, prototype-key names, and empty-range aggregates.
GRAPH: diff cycleCells against brute-force self-reachability on random graphs; also probe a deep chain for recursion limits.
